paragraphs: In [Sukkah 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.15b.3) they said: “Shall we say this supports him?” and Abaye explains his words there.[^1]

notes.text: The Gemara asks on 15b whether the mishnah supports Rabbi Ami bar Tavyomi’s ruling about worn vessels. Abaye explains what counts as a worn vessel on [Sukkah 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.16a.3).
